packageArguments.description: Absolute path to the single folder to serve, read-only. Wins over WYRD_GRANT. Any path inside it can be requested, hidden entries included, such as .env and .git/config, apart from a handful of name spellings refused as input: a drive-letter-and-colon prefix such as C:notes on every host, and on Windows a colon inside a component (which names a data stream rather than a file) or a reserved device name such as NUL.md. What comes back is narrower than what can be requested: a directory is refused, and so are bytes that are not valid UTF-8. That limits what is readable, not what is reachable; grant a subfolder containing only what you mean to share.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_ENABLE_COMMANDS

environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for reads. Prefix-based with implicit recursion; case-insensitive; trailing slashes normalized. Unset = full vault. Write paths are implicitly readable. Example: 'public/,projects/'.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS

environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for writes. Same syntax as OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS. Unset = full vault, or the read scope when reads are restricted. Example: 'projects/,scratch/'.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS

environmentVariables.description: Global read-only kill switch. When true, every write is denied regardless of OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS, and the command-palette pair is suppressed (commands can mutate). Useful for shared or public-facing deployments.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in delete confirmation. When true, obsidian_delete_note asks the user to confirm each delete through an elicitation round (the client must support elicitation), and HTTP startup requires a stateful session unless OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY=true disables the tool. Off by default — the delete runs on the first call, bounded by OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS and OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_DELETE_ELICITATION

server.description: Budget-bound x402 payment wallet for AI agents — pays HTTP 402 URLs, capped locally. No backend.

environmentVariables.description: Your wallet's private key/seed for the chosen chain. Optional: omit it to run read-only (discover/quote/register/budget/guide); set it to let the agent pay. Stays on your machine; the spend policy caps every payment.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Chain to pay on (default: base).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_CHAIN

environmentVariables.description: Pay across several chains (instead of PIPRAIL_CHAIN): a comma-separated list, e.g. base,polygon,solana. Give each its own PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_KEY (+ optional PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_RPC_URL). The agent pays whichever chain a 402 asks for — the first listed that can settle — under one shared budget.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_CHAINS

environmentVariables.description: Max spend per single payment, in token units (default: 0.10).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_AMOUNT

environmentVariables.description: Lifetime spend cap per token, in token units (default: 10.00).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL

environmentVariables.description: Cross-token GRAND TOTAL: one spend cap per denomination across every stablecoin and chain, e.g. USD:20.00,EUR:5.00. Not a price oracle — sums tokens of the same unit, each counted 1:1. Native coins are excluded.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL_DENOM

environmentVariables.description: Lifetime cap on the NUMBER of payments, across every chain + token (e.g. 100).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS

environmentVariables.description: Cap on the number of payments within PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS (a rolling rate limit; set PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS too).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS_PER_WINDOW

environmentVariables.description: Emit an early-warning event when spend crosses this fraction of any cap, e.g. 0.8 (80%). Needs PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG to be visible.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_WARN_AT_FRACTION

environmentVariables.description: Path to a local append-only spend log. When set, the budget (lifetime, grand total, counts) SURVIVES a restart — hydrated from this file. No backend; you own the file.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_SPEND_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Mirror payment events (settled / declined / budget-threshold) as one-line JSON to 'stderr' or a file path — the operator's notification stream. Default: off.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed token symbols, plus the alias 'native' for the chain's coin (default: USDC).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated payment schemes to settle (default: onchain-proof). Add 'exact' (onchain-proof,exact) to also pay standard x402 servers GASLESS on EVM + Solana (method auto-selected). Add 'upto' to also pay metered x402 servers on EVM (Permit2): sign a MAX, the server settles the actual <= max.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_SCHEMES

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to close the shared "global" namespace on this server. Every call that routes there is refused before the request is sent, and the tools stop offering it as an example. Unset leaves it available. A value that is neither a yes nor a no stops the server rather than being read as no.
environmentVariables.name: NOETIVE_DISABLE_GLOBAL_NS

environmentVariables.description: An OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint you run. Set it and embeddings are computed on this machine rather than by Noetive: a publish carries the vector alongside its text, and a query's anchor phrases are replaced by vectors so they are never sent. This is not confidential publishing: message text still travels, because that is what a search returns. The endpoint must answer to the same model name as NOETIVE_MODEL and return NOETIVE_DIMENSIONS values. Plain http is accepted only for a loopback address. Inside a container 127.0.0.1 is the container itself; use host.docker.internal.

environmentVariables.description: An OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint you run. Set it and embeddings are computed on this machine rather than by Noetive: a publish carries the vector alongside its text, and a query's anchor phrases are replaced by vectors so they are never sent. This is not confidential publishing: message text still travels, because that is what a search returns. The endpoint must answer to the same model name as NOETIVE_MODEL and return NOETIVE_DIMENSIONS values. Plain http is accepted only for a loopback address. Inside a container 127.0.0.1 is the container itself; use host.docker.internal.
